description: Source code for TranscodingUidPolicy class managing UID importance monitoring and callbacks in Android media transcoding context.

classes.name: TranscodingUidPolicy
classes.description: Manages UID importance monitoring, callback registration, and top UID determination for media transcoding.

methods.name: TranscodingUidPolicy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the policy and registering self.

methods.name: ~TranscodingUidPolicy
methods.description: Destructor unregistering the UID importance listener.

methods.name: OnUidImportance
methods.description: Static callback invoked on UID importance change, forwarding to instance method.

methods.name: registerSelf
methods.description: Registers UID importance listener if API is available.

methods.name: unregisterSelf
methods.description: Unregisters UID importance listener if API is available.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback interface for UID policy events.

methods.name: registerMonitorUid
methods.description: Adds a UID to monitoring, initializing its importance state.

methods.name: isUidOnTop
methods.description: Checks if a UID is currently on top based on importance.

methods.name: getTopUids
methods.description: Returns the set of UIDs with the highest importance.

methods.name: onUidStateChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a UID's importance changes, updating internal state and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: updateTopUid_l
methods.description: Updates the top UID importance state based on monitored UIDs.

methods.name: getProcState_l
methods.description: Retrieves the current importance state of a UID.
